transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess… I’m here because I’m having trouble keeping my mind on things. At work, I’ll look at a loan worksheet or a follow-up list and realize I’ve read the same line over and over. Then I put off calls because even simple decisions feel harder than they should.
Have you noticed any loss of interest or pleasure in activities that you usually enjoy?

Yes… I guess I have. Most days it just feels kind of heavy. Even things I usually like, like going to the community center or working in my garden, I’m there, but… not really enjoying it. More like I’m just doing it and trying to look okay.
Have you noticed a decrease in your energy level or felt more fatigued lately, even when you haven’t been physically active?
Yes… I have. I wake up tired, even if I slept through the night. And after just a couple of client calls, or even watering the tomatoes, I feel like I’ve already done a full day.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep lately, like trouble falling asleep, staying asleep, or waking up earlier than usual?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I’ve noticed a clear change like that… my sleep is just kind of what it is.
Have you found yourself feeling more guilty or like you’re not worth much lately?
I don’t know… not more than usual, I guess. I don’t really think about it that way.
How long have these feelings been going on? Can you pinpoint when you first noticed them or if they’ve been building up over time?
I guess… it’s been a little over two years. Since my close friend died. It sort of started around then and just… kept going.
